what: `blaze check --fix --lib -p blaze-std` made the suggestions of every crate in the checkout the check reached (blaze-sys, vendor/quinn-proto), not of blaze-std alone, and two of those are wrong as written: `clippy::disallowed_methods` of `std::mem::forget` in blaze-sys (a `no_std` crate) gave E0433 `cannot find module or crate std` at crates/blaze-sys/src/linux/fs.rs, and suggestions in vendor/quinn-proto gave E0432 unresolved imports `crate::connection::Chunks` and five more, E0308 in frame.rs and `bindings_with_variant_name`. Then every effect lint said `into_raw` "has a body that does not lower to MIR: MissingFunctionDefinition", which was the unresolved `std` path, not a fault of the effect checks.
cost: the 137k-line output read as a compiler bug in MIR lowering until the last twelve lines were read
cause: the fixer took every diagnostic whose file is in the checkout; the two lints' fixes were never run on a no_std crate or on quinn-proto
fix: fixed for the scope (UnitOf::primary, commit a0a553886 on bstd-builds-1112); the two wrong fixes are still wrong and would show with `--fix -p blaze-sys` and `--fix -p quinn-proto`: a what-if error should name the suggestion that caused it (lint and span), which the fixer can find by bisecting the ops
state: fixed for the scope with a0a553886; the wrong fixes open
